summary: Equinox Gold filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing redemption of all $172.5 million outstanding 4.75% convertible senior notes due October 2028. The issuer will redeem at 100% of principal plus accrued interest, approximately $1,000.66 per $1,000 note, on October 20, 2026, with a conversion deadline of 5:00 p.m. New York time on October 19, 2026. The conversion rate is 158.7302 shares per $1,000, adjusted to 165.0732 for converting holders. Computershare is trustee and paying agent. Watch for equity overhang from conversions and take-up versus cash redemption.
